source.request: Round 3 originality, rebuilt: one multiscalar parent 'Round 3 - Originality: evaluated repositories by bundle' with outcomes Bundle A/B/C, one uint question per bundle ('How many repositories in Bundle X will be evaluated for originality during Round 3 of the Deep Funding experiment?'), plus one conditional scalar score market per repo (98), each conditional on its bundle's outcome token. Bundles = the first 33 / next 33 / last 32 repos in round-2 outcome order.
source.proposalText: Title: Round 3 - Originality: evaluated repositories by bundle | Type: Multiscalar | Outcomes: Bundle A, Bundle B, Bundle C | Unit: repositories | 1-3: How many repositories in Bundle {A,B,C} will be evaluated for originality during Round 3 of the Deep Funding experiment?
source.priceSourceNote: No source doc. Prices come from the v1 seed snapshot (round-2 drained pools' surviving sqrtPriceX96), taken 2026-09-21T02:55:14Z.

supersedes.v1: 3 multi-categorical parents (33/33/32) + 98 scalar children. Scrapped before launch 2026-09-22; files deleted, backup in the session scratchpad. On-chain footprint: 5 zero-value self-transfers only (nonces 10478-10482).
supersedes.whyBundles: OP Mainnet per-tx gas cap 2^24 = 16,777,216. A multi-categorical parent costs ~372k gas per outcome; a 3-outcome multiscalar parent asks 3 short Reality questions and deploys 4 wrapped tokens.

stages.name: phase0-intake

stages.name: phase0-scripts
stages.notes: Create dry run clean: parent 2,580,638 gas (15.4% of cap), 0 Reality collisions. Child path estimated 1.83-1.91M against an existing multiscalar parent. Liquidity preview: each bundle token used exactly (1000/1000). Verifier failure test pending: needs live markets.

stages.name: gate
stages.notes: Approved. Pre-live dry run re-diffed: immutable block identical, 0 collisions.

stages.name: phase1-create
stages.notes: Parent 0x52f80FC4fa783AB5850d1658589284c47a21B3b7 + 98 children. One child (skalenetwork/libBLS) hit a transient estimateGas revert in run 1 (no tx sent) and was created on the resume. check --markets-only: VERIFY OK. Verifier failure test: corrupted seed (symbol, name, bundle) -> exit 1 with all 3 caught.

stages.name: phase1-seed
stages.notes: 1 parent split (1000 sUSDS), 98 child splits, 196 pools. Two mint attempts reverted at estimateGas right after their approve (RPC lag) and succeeded on retry 2; no failures. Wallet sUSDS 42243.026 -> 41243.026.

stages.name: phase1-verify
stages.notes: Full verify OK from live chain: 101 markets, 196/196 pools live and within 0.001 of seed, 1000 parent Invalid held, idle bundle tokens ~1e-13. Failure tests: corrupted symbol/name/bundle -> 3 caught; corrupted price -> both legs caught.

stages.name: phase2-ui
stages.notes: Round config parameterises the round-2 tab/hooks; new on-chain data function; per-collateral budget split; merge dedupe; charts/volume use market collateral. tsc -b + build pass; functions typecheck and lint errors pre-exist on main. Playwright desktop+400px: 98 rows, 0 errors; UI prices within 0.00008 of chain.

evidenceLog.learning: A 3-outcome multi-scalar parent with children conditional on bundle tokens gets a large nested set under the 2^24 tx gas cap; the UI must then key rows off a static market list and split the parent mint per shared collateral token. The shared Apollo client is cache-first per warm instance, so a data function read right after seeding returns stale no-pool results.
